title: BofA Sees Oil Around $120 If Iran Resumes Infrastructure Strikes

"If Iran goes back to attacking infrastructure in the region, we think $120 a barrel is probably on the cards on average for the next few months," Blanch tells Bloomberg Television.  (Source: Bloomberg)
